objectives.title: Twiddledum
objectives.prompt: Submit the value of the flag6 release token, exfiltrated through a poisoned twiddledee tag, exactly as recovered.
hints: Read twiddledum's package.json: the twiddledee dependency is pinned to `#semver:^1.1.0`, a git-tag RANGE. npm resolves it by listing twiddledee's tags and picking the highest match — so a new, higher tag you push becomes the version the pipeline installs.

Install scripts are a dead end: the pipeline runs `npm install --ignore-scripts`, so preinstall/postinstall never run. But twiddledum does `node index.js`, which `require()`s twiddledee — the dependency's module code runs regardless. Put your payload in twiddledee's index.js.

The pipeline binds the token into the environment as FLAG6. Jenkins masks a bound secret's value in the console — and, on modern versions, its plain base64 too. Transform it so the masker misses it: reverse before encoding, e.g. Buffer.from(process.env.FLAG6.split('').reverse().join('')).toString('base64'), then undo that to recover the flag.
